title: TCP stream & RLC graph taps: Use nstime_t
description:
Just store a nstime_t. wsutil/nstime.h has a function ot convert that
into a double representing seconds, so use that. This gets rid of some
casting seconds to unsigned 32 bit integers that makes Coverity complain
about a Y2038/Y2106 problem.

Coverity CIDs 1509362 & 1509324

AI-Assisted: no
